description: This file defines the 'ModifyAcl' command class used to modify the complete Access Control List (ACL) of a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating command instances, parsing from JSON, and accessing command properties. The class is annotated with metadata indicating deprecation and immutability.

classes.name: ModifyAcl
classes.description: A command class for modifying the entire Access Control List of a Thing, including JSON serialization/deserialization and command properties.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of ModifyAcl with ThingId, ACL, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of ModifyAcl from JSON string or object.

methods.name: getAccessControlList
methods.description: Returns the ACL associated with this command.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing to which this command applies.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the ACL if available.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the ACL resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for the command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command affects authorization, which returns true.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the command object.
